action.objective: Win the a6 knight with Nxa6, then complete kingside castling and convert the extra pawn.
action.rationale: b4a6 (Nxa6) is the only commit-ready move: exact score 1611 at completed depth 4, safety complete with no immediate mate, tactical_refutation not_found, no proven refutations, replan not required. The move wins Black's a6 knight; if bxa6 recaptures, White has already traded a knight for a knight while Black's pawn structure is damaged. After castling (e1g1) White's king is safe and the d4 pawn plus bishop pair give a solid positional edge. The broad-search top rows (b4a6 at 1667 was itself the suggested exact move; e5f7, d1e2, d4c5 were upper bounds and unverified), so no stronger evidence justifies deviating. Black's likely reply cxd4 or bxa6 does not refute the line per verification PV.
